description: Surface feature-scoped contribution opportunities in repos where you already have 3+ merged PRs. Returns two ranked buckets: "quick wins" (low maintainer-commitment) and "bigger bets" (milestone / roadmap / accepted-RFC labels). Read-only.

anchorThreshold.description: Per-call override for the merged-PR threshold that qualifies a repo as an anchor (default 3).

maxResults.description: Total number of opportunities to return across both buckets (default: 10, max: 100).

splitRatio.description: Per-call override for the quick-win share of results (default 0.6 = 60%).

name: features
